Such individuals are recognized for their dedication and commitment to preserving the sacred text.

By naming a child Mahzala, parents invest their child with the hope and expectation of becoming a guardian of knowledge, a keeper of the divine words, and thus contributing to the ongoing preservation of the Islamic faith and the broader human knowledge. This spiritual significance of the name Mahzala is a powerful reminder of the importance of knowledge preservation, deepening our appreciation for the intricacies of our sacred texts, and inspiring dedication towards the pursuit of knowledge.
